text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=model-catalog-service (sev=high). page: PD12345. detected: config drift on 'model_defaults' during autopromote job.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 -> triggered -> notification sent to schedule 'sre-oncall'

Maya (oncall): Acked. looking. any customer-facing errors? :eyes:

Emma (support): Getting reports: a couple customers hitting tokenizer errors, also 502s when creating endpoints. Support ticket count: 3 open, 2 high.

Ravi (sre): Quick check: catalog service recently ran autopromote job at 1769989000. I see the new revision pinned to legacy tokenizer (tokenizer=v1) instead of v2. That explains tokenization mismatches.

Noah (platform): Confirmed. autopromote pipeline promoted rev=2026-03-15-09:12 -> default config includes `tokenizer: v1` even though model binary expects `tknr-v2`. Looks like a migration step failed.

Priya (prod-resp): Impact: endpoints using the default template get bad tokenization -> downstream decoders throw length/encoding errors -> some inference requests return 502 or truncated output. Not universal but affects any route that didn't pin explicit tokenizer.

Maya (oncall): Actions: 1) stop autopromote job 2) pin catalog default back to previous safe revision 3) push hotfix to autopromote config to enforce tokenizer mapping 4) notify customers in tickets. I'll take 1 and 2 now.

Ravi (sre): I'm on 3. preparing a config patch. quick rollback command:
```
# pin previous catalog revision
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://catalog.internal/api/v1/pin \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1","revision":"2026-03-14-22:05","reason":"rollback autopromote bad tokenizer"}'
```

Noah (platform): I'm pausing the autopromote cron: `kubectl scale deployment autopromote --replicas=0 -n infra`

Maya (oncall): Done: pinned to 2026-03-14-22:05. Autopromote scaled to 0. ETA for hotfix?

Ravi (sre): Patch ready, running canary against dev tenant now. change: ensure `tokenizer` field is validated and fallback is `tknr-v2` for any model that bundles v2 weights. Also added a safety check to prevent promotion if tokenizer mismatch detected between manifest and binary.

Priya (prod-resp): Please add a regression alert for eval prompt set 'tokenizer-regress' so we detect this in CI.

Ravi (sre): Will do. Canary looks good (dev traffic 5k reqs/min) no tokenization errors. Rolling hotfix to staging then prod.

Emma (support): Notifying affected customers in the 3 open tickets that we have a mitigation in flight and ETA ~15-25m.

Maya (oncall): After hotfix, we'll unpin and re-run autopromote offline once we confirm mapping. Also create postmortem stub. assigning incident owner: Priya.

Priya (prod-resp): Got it. I'll collect impacted routes, customer ids, and prepare a brief impact statement.

Noah (platform): Note: adding a quick one-off script to scan catalog for mismatch:
```
python tools/catalog_audit.py --check-tokenizer --since 2026-03-01
```
I'll run and post results.

Ravi (sre): Prod hotfix rolled 1769991320. Monitoring telemetry: 502 rate dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. tokenization errors count -> 0 in last 5m.

Maya (oncall): Confirming recovery. paging -> close when PD auto-clear? I'll wait for support to confirm ticket updates. :thumbsup:

Emma (support): Customers updated. two asked for a short RCA once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: PD12345 has been resolved (ack cleared) by Maya (oncall).

Priya (prod-resp): Incident owner note: root cause = autopromote job promoted a catalog revision with inconsistent tokenizer metadata. Fixes: hotfix to validation, automated audit, add canary gating to autopromote. I'll open postmortem doc and link after 30m.

Maya (oncall): Thanks team. handing off to Priya for postmortem + customer comms. I'll stand down.

Noah (platform): Ran the audit: 1 other model with mismatched tokenizer metadata flagged (low traffic). I'll patch and add to rollout queue.

Ravi (sre): Adding followups to run: alert for tokenizer-regress, unit test on autopromote, add config schema validation.

Priya (prod-resp): Collecting timelines and will post the RCA link here when ready.

Maya (oncall): Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
